name: JJGA 特定非営利活動法人日本ジュニアゴルフ協会 — 決勝大会 results (石川遼カップ決勝, Jr.プレーヤーズ東西決勝, オールスター, 東横イン決勝, RMJ 宮里・青木・成田カップ, 小平智カップ決勝, スプリング/大東建託 東西決勝)
publishes: Per-event result PDFs per division (8-9/10-11/12-14/15-18歳). 15-18 division rows: rank, to-par, name, grade (circled 1-3), 所在地 prefecture, OUT/IN per round, total. NO school names.
years_available: 2016-2026 finals (2024-2026 parsed: 24 events x boys/girls = 48 division files, 1015 rows)
terms_note: robots.txt only disallows /wp/wp-admin/. JJGA Webサービス利用規約 (https://www.jjga.org/common/pdf/agreement.pdf) 第8条: all IP of the JJGA website belongs to JJGA/licensors and '当協会に無断で知的財産権を使用（複製、送信、譲渡、二次利用を含む）することは禁じます'. Same situation as k-hga.jp (consent required for reuse). Server also resets connections intermittently (handled with retries, >=1s spacing).
reason: Parsed and validated, but NOT written to data/raw/jjga pending the user's decision on the JJGA terms clause (unauthorized reproduction/secondary use prohibited, analogous to the k-hga exclusion). Also no school names: HS status inferred only from the 15-18 division + grade 1-3.

name: JJGA 地区大会 (regional qualifiers) results
publishes: Per-venue one-round result PDFs (convention/<year>/<series>/pdf/MMDD_<venue>_result.pdf) incl. 15-18歳の部; rows show rank, name, grade, OUT/IN/total only (no school, no prefecture)
years_available: 2024-2026 pages exist (~28 result PDFs per series per year, 5-6 series)
reason: Same terms concern; also very thin identity data (no school/prefecture) so name matching would be unreliable. One sample PDF checked only.

name: JJGA SAHARA ranking (JJGAランキング)
publishes: Ranking PDFs per age division incl. 15-18 boys/girls (e.g. 260907_rank_15-18boys.pdf)
reason: Points ranking, not tournament results (does not fit the per-tournament JSON format); terms concern.

name: JJGT 日本ジュニアゴルフツアー (社団法人日本ゴルフツアー協会)
publishes: Result PDFs (/tour-info/result/rNNNN.pdf): rank, name, prefecture, age division (18歳以下/16歳以下/14歳以下...), score, points
terms_note: robots.txt returns 404 (no restrictions). Terms page not reviewed in detail.
reason: No school or grade; age divisions are 'under 18 / under 16' (mix junior-high and HS), so HS players cannot be identified; fields are small and mostly elementary-age. Out of scope per brief (only HS-identifiable rows).
